provenance: Verified against the local CIMCO Edit 2026 install + decompiled CHM help (resources/cimco-2026/_extracted/edit_us/*.htm). Each executable's path + sizeBytes was confirmed on disk. Launch patterns are marked verified:true (documented behavior AND exe present) vs needsLiveVerify:true (plausible from CIMCO conventions but NOT confirmable without driving the live licensed app). No CLI flag is asserted unless documented — a `strings` scan of CIMCOEdit.exe surfaced no usage banner, so beyond the file-open arg the compare/batch flags stay unverified (R12 fail-loud).

executables.role: main NC editor; hosts File Compare and Machine Simulation
3D machine-simulation engine/viewer (the sim-verdict surface; the SPINE-2 UIA report reader targets this)
license/key manager — a valid license must be present before Machine Simulation runs

launchPatterns.purpose: Open a generated NC program in the editor, bypassing the File > Open GUI dialog. The blind-preferred way to load a candidate post for inspection/compare.
launchPatterns.source: nav-map editor.file.open (channel cli) + standard Windows file-association behavior

launchPatterns.purpose: Open two files (golden + candidate) ready for side-by-side File Compare. CIMCO Edit accepts multiple file args, but the File-Compare ACTION itself is UIA-only — there is no documented compare CLI flag.
launchPatterns.source: inferred from CIMCO multi-file open convention; compare invocation unconfirmed blind

launchPatterns.purpose: Replay an archived simulation/presentation bundle in the standalone Presentation Viewer without the full editor. Lets a proven post's collision/position record be re-inspected later.
launchPatterns.source: nav-map pv.app (channel cli, presentation-viewer.htm) — viewer exe name + arg unconfirmed on this install

integrationHook.where: Editor Setup > External Commands (surfaces in the NC Functions tab > Commands menu)
integrationHook.mechanism: Configure External Command 1 or 2 to call an external program; CIMCO appends macro-substituted args and (optionally) reads/uses the configured $OUTFILE for the result. This is a FILE-channel hook — fully blind-drivable, no UIA needed.

macros.$OUTFILE: output file name as configured below (e.g. $PATH\$FILENOEXT.NEW)

integrationHook.prismUse: Register PRISM's post-verifier as External Command 1 (title e.g. 'PRISM Verify'). From inside CIMCO on the currently open NC file the operator invokes it; PRISM receives $FILEPATH, runs prism_cimco verification, and writes the verdict to $OUTFILE. This is the blind-safe integration path that needs NO UIA automation — it complements (does not replace) the SPINE-2 UIA Simulation-Report reader, which is still required for the in-app Machine-Simulation collision verdict.

licenseGate.note: Machine Simulation requires a valid CIMCO license (managed by Sys/KeyManager.exe). A blind launch can open + text-edit + (UIA) text-compare a program, but the SIMULATION VERDICT half (collision/over-travel/gouge) is gated on a live license AND UIA — see the SPINE-2 UIA Simulation-Report reader keystone.
